body.name: Three-state cutoff-forest messages
body.construction: Fix an independent \(\mathcal U\subseteq\mathcal K\), a blocker set \(\mathcal B\subseteq\mathcal K\setminus\mathcal U\), and core priorities \(x\in(0,1)^{\mathcal K}\). For \(v\notin\mathcal K\), put \(p_v(x)=\max(\{x_u:u\in\mathcal U\cap N_{C_G}(v)\}\cup\{0\})\) and \(r_v(x)=\min(\{x_f:f\in\mathcal B\cap N_{C_G}(v)\}\cup\{1\})\). Root each component of \(C_G-\mathcal K\). For a child \(w\) define \(J_w=\int_0^1B_w(t,z)\,dt\), \(D_w=\int_0^1(A_w(t,z)+B_w(t,z))\,dt\), and \(E_w(y)=J_w+\int_0^yA_w(t,z)\,dt\). With \(f_v(y)=h_{\ell v}y^{h_{\ell v}-1}\), set \(A_v(y,z)=zf_v(y)\mathbf 1\{N_{C_G}(v)\cap\mathcal U=\varnothing\}\mathbf 1\{y<r_v(x)\}\prod_w(J_w+\int_0^yC_w(t,z)\,dt)\), \(C_v(y,z)=f_v(y)\mathbf 1\{y\ge p_v(x)\}\prod_wE_w(y)\), and \(B_v(y,z)=f_v(y)\prod_wD_w-C_v(y,z)\); at a tagged forest vertex set \(B_v=C_v=0\).
